note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified; the substituted value is supplied by the author and nothing is decided by the animation.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional club rule with three cumulative conditions, every piece seated after the test turn. The reading glass lifts pocket 2; its status is replaced (supplied → pending): the piece slides out, both mesh contacts split, and back in context the joint dial springs back to its open end.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional rule with four conditions where piece 3 starts pending (its pocket empty, the test turn stops at the gap). The substitution runs the other way (pending → supplied): the piece slides into its pocket, both contacts engage and, back in context, a new test turn carries the joint dial to its end.
